findings.evidence: `def relators` (line 76) and `def relatorSet` (line 85) carry no `@[expose]`; repo convention confirms bodies are hidden without it (`grep -rn '@\[expose\]' TauCeti/` → 392 hits; `TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGeometry/...`, `TauCeti/Analysis/CompletelyMonotone/Basic.lean:77 @[expose] def IsCompletelyMonotone`). Only `length_relators` (line 81) mentions `relators`.
findings.fix: Restate as the semantic characterization `r ∈ P.relatorSet ↔ ∃ t ∈ P.transcribed, t.toFreeGroup = r` (proved via `List.mem_map` and `Relator.toWord_toFreeGroup`, not `Iff.rfl`), and add `@[simp] mem_relators_iff : w ∈ P.relators ↔ ∃ t ∈ P.transcribed, t.toWord = w`.
findings.issue: `mem_relatorSet_iff` restates membership in terms of `P.relators`, which is an unexposed `def` (line 76) with only a length lemma. Downstream there is no way to get from `r ∈ P.relatorSet` to the transcribed expressions, so `PresentedGroup.toGroup`'s obligation `∀ r ∈ P.relatorSet, FreeGroup.lift f r = 1` is undischargeable outside this file, and `Relator.toWord_toFreeGroup` never reaches the relation set.

findings.evidence: Line 106 `def matchesMetadata (P : GroupPresentation) : Prop :=`, no `@[expose]`, no accompanying lemma or instance anywhere in the file. Compare `TauCeti/Algebra/Group/Conj.lean:130-134`, where the unexposed `def IsRealClass : Prop` is paired with `@[simp] theorem isRealClass_iff_inv_eq`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem matchesMetadata_iff (P) : P.matchesMetadata ↔ P.generatorCount = P.expectedGeneratorCount ∧ P.transcribed.length = P.expectedRelatorCount` and `instance (P) : Decidable P.matchesMetadata := decidable_of_iff _ (matchesMetadata_iff P).symm`.
findings.issue: `matchesMetadata` is an unexposed `def ... : Prop` with no `_iff` lemma and no `Decidable` instance, so no consumer can prove, destructure, or `decide` it — yet the module docstring (line 30) and the file header advertise it as "the executable generator and relator count check". The roadmap requires both counts to be "decidably checkable" and `presentation_matchesMetadata` to be discharged per row.

findings.evidence: Line 116 proof is `P.length_relators.trans h`; `matchesMetadata` at line 106 has no exposure or `_iff` lemma, so `h` cannot be obtained from it in another module.
findings.fix: Either delete it (it follows from `length_relators` by `simp [h]`) or restate it to take `h : P.matchesMetadata` directly, once `matchesMetadata_iff` exists.
findings.issue: `length_relators_eq_expected` is a one-step wrapper over the `@[simp]` `length_relators`, and its docstring claim that "a presentation satisfying `matchesMetadata` supplies this hypothesis as its second conjunct" is false downstream, since `matchesMetadata` is opaque and cannot be projected.

summary: The three core definitions (`relators`, `relatorSet`, `matchesMetadata`) are unexposed `def`s with no characteristic lemmas tying them back to `transcribed`, so outside this file the relation set cannot be computed and `matchesMetadata` cannot be proved or decided at all — which blocks exactly the S1/A0 consumers this format exists for.
